command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes' -Method Get).name; foreach(`$n in `$nodes){foreach(`$c in @('display current-configuration','show running-config')){`$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n'; `$m=`$o | Where-Object {`$_ -match '150\.0\.0\.1|160\.0\.0\.1'}; if(`$m){Write-Output ('=== '+`$n+' ==='); `$m; break}}}"
